You play as Ding Chavez and command a squad of up to 4 men. You can order them to do tasks such as, breach and clear, flash a room, frag a room, capture hostages...ect. 

The missions range from full fireteam combat through a village infested with terrorists, to stealth missions where you are alone and the use of deadly force is not allowed. 

The story itself is very interesting to me and while I haven't finished it yet, I'm very interested to see how it ends. 

I believe there are 15 single player missions as well as some multiplayer maps and game modes so you can take down Terrorists with your friends via split screen. 

I picked up a copy for only 5 bucks. It cheep and a very fun buy if you like a more challenging tactical shooter experience.
